name: Temporary Residence for Employment Purposes (long-stay visa D/AM)

requirements.blocker_text: Employer-sponsored job offer, applied for via the D/AM long-stay employment visa under Law No. 200/2010.

outcome.duration_length: tied to employment contract; standard permit duration/renewability cycle and any labour-market-test or quota mechanism were not confirmed on a tier-1/2 source in this build -- open gap

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Republic of Moldova -- types of visas: D/AM long-stay employment visa; separate categories exist for IT-park employees (D/IT, Law 77/2016), intra-company transfers (D/TP), internships (D/FT), not separately modeled here
ILO NATLEX -- Law No. 200/2010 on the Regime of Foreigners in the Republic of Moldova (full text mirror, employment chapter not independently reached in this pass)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Moldova). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- the core hard requirement (employer-sponsored D/AM visa) is tier-1 MFA sourced. GAP, EXPLICITLY DISCLOSED: no tier-1/2 source with current labour-market-test or quota figures was located -- only tier-3/4 relocation-agency guides had specific numbers, and those are NOT used here. Separate sub-visa categories exist for IT-park employees, intra-company transfers, and interns but are not separately modeled -- disclosed as a scope decision. pr_after_months (60) and citizenship_after_months (120) are cross-referenced from md_permanent_residence.json and md_citizenship_naturalisation.json respectively, not independently sourced here.
